rubrics.justification: Mostly plausible blastocyst description, but it repeatedly questions the reported 4AA/hatching status, states no obvious hatching despite lab data saying herniating through zona, and gives somewhat equivocal TE/ICM assessments from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, prior live birth, BMI, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, smoking, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is generally logical and the prognosis estimate is tied to embryo quality, age-related aneuploidy risk, and clinical context; minor inconsistency remains around the embryo stage versus the reported lab grade.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including single embryo transfer, luteal support, smoking cessation, and optional PGT-A discussion; slight overreach in image-based re-grading lowers the score.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer optimization, smoking cessation, nutrition, follow-up testing, and future-cycle review, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than highly protocol-specific.
